purpose: Locate an event within an available time window.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Plain nonpast verb / ている + 間に; noun + の間に.
I cleaned while my mother was out.
I asked the teacher a question during the break.
I sent an email while waiting for the train.
Use an opportunity before it changes or act within an interval
うちに · before the opportunity changes
formation: Plain nonpast verb / ている + 間に; noun + の間に.
restrictions: The main event occurs within the interval rather than necessarily lasting throughout it.
mistake: Do not assume 間に means the two actions continue for the same duration.
